SongComments.SongComment: This song was firstly made during year 1997 on Fast Tracker 2.
It had every sort of pattern madness: pattern loops, pattern delays, slow arpeggios, fake surround, ghost instruments, and so on..
Some of that old techniques can't be used anymore on modern trackers, but can be still faked somehow, as you see..
REMEMBER! Technic is a medium, not an aim!
